activity_summary: At breakfast Mistress Ansell said she was going to the Theatre in her church hat. She had never been inside a playhouse. Alse was to sit beside her and not to ask a further question. Gillis Verbeke stayed at the loom. You named no price for the seat. She said she was not discussing a second time. You left before them.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Left the price unspoken, and went ahead of them.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Decided on the church hat and one visit, and refused a procession.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Agreed to sit beside her, and stopped a second question.

entities.name: Gillis Verbeke
entities.context: Stayed with the loom, and left the kitchen able to receive them.

facets.activity: Heard Mistress Ansell decide to see the play

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: I am going, Master Shakespeare. Church hat.

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: Once is a thing I have decided. I am not discussing a second time at breakfast.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not naming a price for your seat.
